clarification_issue.title: [CLARIFICATION] Origin #158: [BACKEND] [STORY] Execution: Issue and Consume Parts

clarifications_resolved.question: The original story mentions 'issued (picked) and parts consumed (installed)'. Does the business process require these to be two distinct actions/events in the system (e.g., a part is picked from the shelf at 10:00 AM, but only installed at 11:30 AM)? Or is it acceptable to treat them as a single atomic transaction ('Issue and Consume') as modeled in this story?
clarifications_resolved.decision: Use single local DB transaction for state + ledger writes and outbox record; publish events asynchronously (no distributed transactions); ensure idempotency keys for retries.

interpretation.atomic_transaction: Issue and Consume SHALL be treated as a single atomic operation from a database transaction perspective
interpretation.single_transaction_scope: A single local database transaction SHALL update work order part consumption state, write ledger/inventory entries, and create outbox record for event publishing
interpretation.async_events: Events SHALL be published asynchronously after the transaction commits
interpretation.no_distributed_tx: NO distributed transactions across multiple systems
interpretation.idempotency_requirement: Idempotency keys MUST be provided to handle retries safely
interpretation.failure_handling: If the transaction fails, no partial state is committed; if event publishing fails, the outbox pattern ensures eventual delivery

clarifications_resolved.question: The original story proposed `workorderId + partId + usageSequence`. This story proposes using the `partUsageEventId` for uniqueness. Please confirm if `{workorderId}-{workorderItemId}-{partUsageEventId}` is the desired deterministic key format. What is the precise definition of `usageSequence` if that is preferred?
clarifications_resolved.decision: Apply standard best practices with explicit contracts, idempotency, audit trails, UTC timestamps, scoped RBAC, configurable defaults.

interpretation.explicit_contracts: All events MUST include explicit contracts (schema definitions)
interpretation.idempotent_processing: All events MUST support idempotent processing
interpretation.audit_trail: Audit trails MUST capture who, when (UTC), what changed, and original/new values
interpretation.timestamps: Timestamps SHALL always be in UTC
interpretation.authorization: Authorization MUST use scoped Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
interpretation.configurable_defaults: System defaults SHALL be configurable per location/organization
interpretation.unique_identification: The `partUsageEventId` provides unique identification for each part consumption event

clarifications_resolved.question: The `InventoryIssued` event must specify whether the accounting impact is to `WIP` or immediate `COGS`. Where is this business rule configured? Is it a system-wide setting, per location, per work order type, or something else? This detail is required to correctly populate the event payload.
clarifications_resolved.decision: Configurable via policy; Accounting consumes events.

interpretation.configurable_policy: The WIP vs. COGS determination SHALL be configurable via policy
interpretation.policy_scopes: Policy configuration may be system-wide default, per location override, per work order type, or other business-defined criteria
interpretation.domain_responsibility: The policy configuration is the responsibility of the work order domain
interpretation.event_payload: The `InventoryIssued` event MUST include the policy determination in its payload
interpretation.accounting_consumption: The Accounting domain consumes the events and applies the policy as specified
interpretation.no_recomputation: Accounting does NOT recompute or override the policy decision
interpretation.source_of_truth: The work order service is the source of truth for the policy at consumption time

business_rules_added.title: Atomic Transaction Requirement
business_rules_added.description: Part issue and consume operations MUST be executed within a single local database transaction that includes work order part consumption state update, inventory ledger entry creation, and outbox record creation for event publishing.

business_rules_added.title: Asynchronous Event Publishing
business_rules_added.description: Events (InventoryIssued, PartConsumed) MUST be published asynchronously after the local transaction commits successfully, using the transactional outbox pattern.

business_rules_added.title: Idempotency Key Standard
business_rules_added.description: All part consumption operations and events MUST use the idempotency key format: `{workorderId}-{workorderItemId}-{partUsageEventId}`. Consumers MUST handle retries idempotently using this key.
business_rules_added.authority: Workexec domain (key format), Cross-cutting concern (idempotency handling)

business_rules_added.title: Audit Trail Requirements
business_rules_added.description: All part consumption operations MUST capture actor identifier, timestamp in UTC, entity changes, idempotency key, and request/event correlation identifiers.

business_rules_added.title: WIP vs COGS Policy Configuration
business_rules_added.description: The determination of whether inventory consumption impacts Work-In-Progress (WIP) or Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) accounts SHALL be configurable via policy. The workexec domain MUST evaluate the policy at consumption time and include the determination in the InventoryIssued event payload.
business_rules_added.authority: Accounting domain (policy definition), Workexec domain (policy evaluation and event payload)

data_entities_added.name: PartUsageEvent
data_entities_added.purpose: Represents a single part consumption event

data_entities_added.name: OutboxEvent
data_entities_added.purpose: Represents events to be published asynchronously

data_entities_added.name: AccountingPolicyConfiguration
data_entities_added.purpose: Configures WIP vs COGS determination rules

acceptance_criteria_added.title: Single Transaction Guarantees Atomicity
acceptance_criteria_added.given: A request to issue and consume a part for a work order item
acceptance_criteria_added.then: All database changes (state update, ledger entry, outbox record) MUST occur within a single local transaction; if any step fails, all changes MUST be rolled back; no partial state MUST be committed

acceptance_criteria_added.title: Events Published Asynchronously
acceptance_criteria_added.given: A successful part consumption transaction has committed
acceptance_criteria_added.then: The InventoryIssued and PartConsumed events MUST be published to the message broker; if publishing fails, the events MUST remain in the outbox for retry; the original transaction MUST NOT be affected by publishing failures

acceptance_criteria_added.title: Idempotency Keys Prevent Duplicate Processing
acceptance_criteria_added.given: A part consumption request with idempotency key {workorderId}-{workorderItemId}-{partUsageEventId}
acceptance_criteria_added.when: The same request is submitted multiple times (e.g., due to retry)
acceptance_criteria_added.then: The system MUST detect the duplicate using the idempotency key; subsequent requests MUST return the same result without reprocessing; only one part consumption record MUST be created

acceptance_criteria_added.title: Complete Audit Trail Captured
acceptance_criteria_added.then: The system MUST capture actor identifier, UTC timestamp, entity changes, idempotency key, and request correlation identifier; this audit trail MUST be queryable for compliance and troubleshooting

acceptance_criteria_added.title: WIP vs COGS Determined by Configured Policy
acceptance_criteria_added.then: The policy configuration MUST be queried based on system-wide default, location-specific override, or work order type-specific override; the policy decision (WIP or COGS) MUST be determined according to the most specific applicable configuration; if no policy is configured, the system MUST use the system-wide default or fail with a clear error

acceptance_criteria_added.title: Policy Decision Included in InventoryIssued Event
acceptance_criteria_added.given: A part consumption has been successfully processed
acceptance_criteria_added.then: The event payload MUST include accountingPolicy field with value WIP or COGS, policy configuration identifier used for the determination, and timestamp of policy evaluation (UTC); the Accounting service MUST consume this event and apply the specified policy without recomputation
